question: Find publications published by Wiley ordered by the number of citations
SQL:
select r.sk_id, r.title, count(*)
from result as r
join result_citations as rc on r.sk_id = rc.sk_result_id_cited
where r.publisher = 'Wiley'
and r.type = 'publication'
group by r.sk_id
order by count(*) desc;

question: Find publications by Haibi about energy
SQL:
select r.*
from result as r
join result_author as ra on r.sk_id = ra.sk_result_id
join author as a on a.sk_id = ra.sk_author_id
join result_fos as rf on rf.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
join fos as f on f.sk_id = rf.sk_fos_id

question: Find papers written before 2010 related to statistics and bioinformatics
SQL:
select r.sk_id, r.title
from result as r
join result_fos as rf on r.id = rf.result_id
join fos as f on f.id = rf.fos_id
where r.type = 'publication'
    and date_part('year', r.publication_date) < 2010
    and f.label = 'statistics & probability'

INTERSECT

select r.sk_id, r.title
from result as r
join result_fos as rf on r.id = rf.result_id
join fos as f on f.id = rf.fos_id
where r.type = 'publication'

    and f.label = 'bioinformatics';

question: Find the publications on bioinformatics after 2017 and before 2020, with 2017 and 2020 excluded

question: Return me the non nano-technology publications by Majid Heravi
SQL:
WITH publications AS (SELECT r.sk_id, r.title, f.label
                      FROM result AS r
                               JOIN result_author AS ra ON ra.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
                               JOIN author AS a ON a.sk_id = ra.sk_author_id
                               JOIN result_fos AS rf ON CAST(rf.sk_result_id AS INT) = r.sk_id
                               JOIN fos as F ON f.sk_id = rf.sk_fos_id
                      WHERE a.fullname = 'Majid Heravi'
                        AND r.type = 'publication')
SELECT DISTINCT publications.title
FROM publications
WHERE
    publications.sk_id NOT IN (SELECT publications.sk_id FROM publications WHERE publications.label = 'nano-technology')

question: Who is the publisher with the most publications in the Transport Research community?
SQL:
SELECT r.publisher, COUNT(*) AS publications_count
FROM result r
    JOIN result_community rc ON r.sk_id = rc.sk_result_id
    JOIN community c ON rc.sk_community_id = c.sk_id
WHERE
    c.name = 'Transport Research'
GROUP BY r.publisher
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Find the number of publications on environmental sciences per year ordered by the publication date
SQL:
SELECT DATE_PART('year', r.publication_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS publications_count
FROM result as r
join result_fos rf on r.id = rf.result_id
join fos f on f.id = rf.fos_id
WHERE f.label = 'environmental sciences'
GROUP BY DATE_PART('year', r.publication_date)
ORDER BY year;

question: Count the citations per publication from publications from US published on Elsevier having at least 3 authors and there are published after 01/01/2010. Sort them by their publication date
SQL:
SELECT r1.sk_id, r1.title, COUNT(rc.result_id_cites), r1.publication_date
FROM result_citations rc
    JOIN result r1 ON rc.sk_result_id_cited = r1.sk_id
    JOIN result r2 ON r2.sk_id=rc.sk_result_id_cites
WHERE r2.sk_id = ANY ( SELECT r3.sk_id
                        FROM result  r3
                            JOIN result_author ON r3.sk_id = result_author.sk_result_id
                        WHERE r3.type = 'publication' AND r3.country ilike '%US%' AND r3.publisher = 'Elsevier BV'  AND r3.publication_date > '01/01/2010'
                        GROUP BY r3.sk_id
                        HAVING COUNT(result_author.sk_author_id) >= 3
                      )
    AND r1.type = 'publication' AND r2.type = 'publication'
GROUP BY r1.sk_id
ORDER BY r1.publication_date;

question: Count the citations per publication from publications from US published on Elsevier having at least 3 authors and there are published after 01/01/2010
SQL:
SELECT r1.sk_id, r1.title, COUNT(rc.result_id_cites)
FROM result_citations rc
    JOIN result r1 ON rc.sk_result_id_cited = r1.sk_id
    JOIN result r2 ON r2.sk_id=rc.sk_result_id_cites
WHERE r2.sk_id = ANY ( SELECT r3.sk_id
                        FROM result  r3
                            JOIN result_author ON r3.sk_id = result_author.sk_result_id
                        WHERE r3.type = 'publication' AND r3.country ilike '%US%' AND r3.publisher = 'Elsevier BV'  AND r3.publication_date > '01/01/2010'
                        GROUP BY r3.sk_id
                        HAVING COUNT(result_author.sk_author_id) >= 3
                      )
    AND r1.type = 'publication' AND r2.type = 'publication'
GROUP BY r1.sk_id;

	JOIN result_hostedby rh ON d.sk_id = rh.sk_datasource_id
	JOIN result r ON rh.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
	JOIN result_citations rc ON r.sk_id = rc.sk_result_id_cited
WHERE r.type = 'publication' and d.type = 'Journal'
GROUP BY d.sk_id, d.officialname
ORDER BY total_citations DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the top 5 journals with the most publications in natural language processing?
SQL:
SELECT d.officialname AS journal_name, COUNT(r.id) AS publication_count
FROM datasource d
JOIN result_hostedby rh ON d.sk_id = rh.sk_datasource_id
JOIN result r ON rh.sk_result_id = r.sk_id
JOIN result_fos rf ON r.sk_id = rf.sk_result_id
JOIN fos f ON rf.sk_fos_id = f.sk_id
WHERE f.label = 'Natural language processing/Computational linguistics'
	AND r.type = 'publication' AND d.type = 'Journal'
GROUP BY d.sk_id, d.officialname
ORDER BY publication_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
